title: Old Dakpema Market & Chief's Courtyard Protocol
description: Visitors entering the Dakpema courtyard greet elders respectfully with 'Naa!' and remove sandals when invited into inner reception spaces.

title: Kukuo Open-Air Clay Firing Mounds
description: Around Kukuo, wide spherical earthenware water pots (duɣu) and soup bowls are sun-dried on swept yards before firing under dry grass and firewood.

title: Lamashegu Pragya & Tricycle Repair Sheds
description: Along the Salaga Road bend in Lamashegu, dozens of open metal-roofed mechanic bays repair Bajaj Pragyas, Motor King cargo trikes, and vulcanize tires.
